classification_note: The three requested shapes overlap. These are observed answer-quality candidates, not a full semantic-correctness score or proposed fixes. Clarifications and no-answer displays were inspected but do not satisfy a pattern requiring a substantive answer.

clusters.name: Requested aspect absent from displayed answer
clusters.mechanism: Generation retained the missing aspect in unsupported_aspects and marked qualified; the published answer rendered answer parts but omitted that gap. Cases 122 and 132 had separate unsupported needs.
clusters.evidence_note: 93 omits 31 August closure; 102 omits monitoring frequency; 122 omits which group is listed first; 132 omits prior initial-contact and Finance Manager responsibility. All four have corresponding unsupported_aspects metadata.

clusters.name: Nearby but different question sense answered
clusters.mechanism: The selected evidence supports adjacent material, but the displayed answer substitutes it for the requested personal amount, form number, event time, historical rule, pilot-review role/frequency, or radio-alert action. In 96 the planner itself converts an undated past-use question to a current-policy aspect. The other cases implicate retrieval/ranking and evidence-to-question responsiveness validation; their individual root causes are not asserted to be identical.
clusters.evidence_note: 51/52 ask for a numbered form but get its title; 84/108 ask for a day/time but get incident context; 102 gets alarm-system monitoring instead of pilot review; 145 disclaims a radio-alert rule then gives general emergency/fire guidance. Cases 21 and 96 substitute policy-level rules for a personal amount and an undated past use respectively.

clusters.name: Named entity coverage not established
clusters.mechanism: The answer offers a parent-site, generic, or present-day rule without establishing that the narrower named outreach setting, individual balance, or past personal event is covered. For 141/142, eligibility has null resolved_location_public_id for unregistered Oakfield outreach and proceeds with generic key-safe evidence. The named-site entailment guard only evaluates site-quoted answer sentences with a detected cited condition.
clusters.evidence_note: 15 displays scope membership for Oakfield Lodge while asked about Oakfield Lodge outreach; 141/142 answer for Oakfield outreach despite null resolved location; 21 lacks individual unused-leave/pay inputs; 96 answers an undated past-use question with current phone rules.
